parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can find this string in the URL for Alibaba Cloud DevOps. For example, in https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}, {organizationId} is the organization ID.

parameters.name: trunkMode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable or disable push review. You need administrator permissions to change this setting.

- true: On

- false: Off
